content.text: Jump to content From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Antonelli in 2022 Andrea Kimi Antonelli (Italian pronunciation: [anˈdrɛ.a ˈki.mi an.toˈnɛl.li]; born 25 August 2006 in Bologna) is an Italian racing driver, who has been competing in the FIA Formula One World Championship for Mercedes AMG Petronas Formula One Team since 2025[1], currently 2nd in the Drivers Championship with 47 Points[2], having taken his maiden win at the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix (with Mercedes).[3]. He is the son of racing driver Marco Antonelli.[4] References[change | change source] ↑ "Kimi Antonelli - Driver - Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1". Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team.
